name: Identifying True ADU Design Specialists in Los Angeles County

mainEntity.name: How can I tell if an ADU design contractor in Los Angeles County is truly specialized in ADUs versus general residential work?
mainEntity.text: How can I tell if an ADU design contractor in Los Angeles County is truly specialized in ADUs versus general residential work?

acceptedAnswer.text: With ADUs surging in popularity, many residential designers now advertise ADU services without deep experience. To gauge true specialization in Los Angeles County, ask each contractor how many ADU projects they have completed in the last two to three years and in which cities or unincorporated areas. Request specific addresses or permit numbers you can spot-check through local permit portals. Review their portfolio for multiple ADU examples—garage conversions, attached, and detached units—rather than just one or two projects mixed among general remodels. Specialists often have standardized workflows, checklists, or guides for ADU feasibility, utility planning, and common jurisdictional issues; ask to see any materials they share with clients. In your initial meeting, notice whether they proactively discuss ADU-specific topics such as parking exemptions, owner-occupancy rules, and rental strategies, versus only talking about finishes and aesthetics. Ask how they stay current on ADU code updates across LA’s patchwork of jurisdictions. A truly specialized ADU design contractor will be able to articulate recurring patterns and pitfalls in ADU projects, not just general home renovation experience.
acceptedAnswer.description: Check how many ADUs they have designed and permitted in the past 2–3 years, ask for recent ADU addresses, review ADU-specific portfolio items, and look for process materials focused on ADU zoning, utilities, and financing. Limited ADU examples or only generic remodels indicate weaker specialization.
